item.name: 03 Design rules (acceptance)
1 client_id in the body is ignored
2 Effective dating: as_of today shows the old name
7a Data scope: Ooty HR sees only Ooty
7b Data scope: Ooty HR cannot open Chennai = 404
8 Masking: head of department sees PAN masked
9 Excel import (dry run): rows imported + rejected = rows in file
